description:
Three platform drivers are currently in [project.dependencies] (pyproject.toml lines 41-43),
meaning uv installs them for every BenchBox user - even those who never run polars,
ClickHouse, or PostgreSQL benchmarks:

  "polars>=1.36.1",          # line 41 - ~20 MB, no reason to force on all users
  "clickhouse-connect>=0.10.0",  # line 42 - cloud-only driver, not needed locally
  "psycopg2-binary>=2.9.11",     # line 43 - PostgreSQL driver, irrelevant for DuckDB users

More importantly, pinning them in core means uv enforces those exact lower-bound
versions on every uv run - a user who manually installs polars==1.20.0 for comparison
testing will have it silently reverted to >=1.36.1.

This was the same problem we fixed for DuckDB (see move-duckdb-to-optional-extras).
The fix is the same: move each package out of core and into a named optional extra.

Current extras state (pyproject.toml):
  - polars: optional extra "polars" already exists at line 222 with "polars>=1.35.2"
  - postgresql: optional extra "postgresql" already exists at line 159 with "psycopg2-binary>=2.9.0"
  - clickhouse-connect: NO clickhouse-connect optional extra exists (only "clickhouse" extra
    at line ~161 uses clickhouse-driver, a different package for a different ClickHouse adapter)

Work required:
  1. Remove the three packages from [project.dependencies]
  2. Add a new "clickhouse-connect" optional extra (analogous to the "duckdb" extra)
  3. Add all three to [project.optional-dependencies].all
  4. Add all three to [dependency-groups].dev (so contributors still get them)
  5. Update README.md installation instructions for each affected platform
